notes: Fix: the default caption presets now ship baked into the app itself, so the whole team always has the full library even if the styles/ folder or Google Drive doesn't reach them (a folder preset of the same name still overrides it, so editing defaults keeps working). Fix: the beta Animation can no longer hide captions — it only plays while the video is actually playing; paused/scrubbing/exact and any word with unknown timing always show fully.
